How this board works

  • Notes (left) stay put while you pan and zoom and save themselves as you type. Drag the bottom-right corner to resize; click the title to fold. Everything is also written into content/_board_thumbs/board_notes.txt — connect it once with Connect board_notes.txt; after a Chrome restart one click on the notes reconnects it.
  • One lane per video, oldest first. Every card = one shot: its start frame, its clip, and under Prompts the exact image prompt, clip prompt, attachments, other takes and notes.
  • Two approvals per video. Frames first: FRAME FOR REVIEW → FRAME APPROVED. Then clips, animated only from approved frames: CLIP FOR REVIEW → APPROVED (or REJECTED → re-rolled as the next take). Take numbers always match the file name.
  • Approve / Reject appear only on cards waiting for you. Each click copies one line for Claude; Review (bottom right) shows only the waiting cards; Copy decisions copies all your lines at once — paste them to Claude.
  • Source of truth: prompts, settings and attachments come from the Higgsfield job that made each file, matched on 2026-09-23 — clips byte-identical to their Higgsfield result (md5), frames by exact file size. THE TREE: a big real fir, dense and dark green, dressed with silver, white and pale blue glass baubles, cream knitted snowflakes, a wide cream linen ribbon wound down it and a silver star on top, with a heavy cream cable-knit tree skirt gathered round its base and four presents wrapped in white paper and green ribbon sitting on it. THE MOTHER: about 32, shoulder-length wavy honey-blonde hair, fair freckled skin and a round face, an oversized forest-green chunky cable-knit sweater with the sleeves pushed up her forearms, charcoal grey joggers and thick oatmeal socks, no shoes.
